about: The first-agent guide's routes and starter models (first_agent.py). Checked 2026-10-27 against the agents' own docs and Hugging Face (repos, files, sizes, licenses). A signed catalog add-on may replace this file; the app reads the add-on's first.

routes.title: Claude Code
routes.access: A Claude plan (Pro, Max, Team) or an API key from console.anthropic.com. The free plan does not include Claude Code.
routes.name: Claude Code

routes.title: Codex
routes.access: A ChatGPT plan (Plus, Pro, Business) or an API key from platform.openai.com.
routes.name: Codex

routes.title: Pi with llama.cpp
routes.access: Runs on this PC: llama.cpp serves a model, Pi talks to it. Downloads need the internet once; then nothing leaves the PC.
routes.name: Pi

routes.title: OpenCode with Ollama
routes.access: Runs on this PC: Ollama serves a model, OpenCode talks to it. Downloads need the internet once; then nothing leaves the PC.
routes.name: OpenCode
